title: Job-order writes
description: The member's writes on aUEC orders through a client, each on an explicit action of the member. Money moves only in the Basetool; there is no undo: a wrong write is repaired in the Basetool.

create.title: Create an aUEC order
create.description: Both units come from the create options: one of the member's requesting units and one of the responsible units. A pair that is not among them answers 400 JOB_ORDER_UNITS_NOT_OFFERED. A create under an Idempotency-Key the client already created an order of the member with answers that order; its terms are never changed.

requestingUnitId.description: The unit that commissions the order: one of the requestingUnits of the create options.

responsibleUnitId.description: The Profit unit that processes the order: one of the responsibleUnits of the create options.

contact.description: Plain text naming whom to contact about the order; the Basetool shows it as text, links are not clickable.

comment.description: Plain text; the Basetool shows it as text, links are not clickable. Absent or null for none.

created.title: Created aUEC order
created.description: Only the order's id, status, versions and stored target; read the order itself from the job-order snapshot or feed. A retry under the create's key answers the same order with its current state.

id.description: The order's id and the feed key. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

cancel.title: Cancel an aUEC order
cancel.description: Cancels an open or in-progress aUEC order of a unit the member writes for, only while no money operation of the order has been accepted. A stale lifecycleVersion answers 409 VERSION_CONFLICT, so a retry after the gateway's one-hour cache does too. There is no undo and no reopen through a client: a mistaken cancel is reopened in the Basetool.

written.title: Written aUEC order
written.description: Only the order's id, status and new versions after a write on an existing order; read the order itself from the job-order snapshot or feed.

id.description: The order's id and the feed key. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

targetChange.title: Change an aUEC order's target
targetChange.description: Raises or lowers the target of an open or in-progress aUEC order of a unit the member writes for, only to an amount above the order's netHandedOver, so the change never completes or reopens the order. A target at or below it answers 409 JOB_ORDER_TARGET_TOO_LOW; completing an order happens in the Basetool. A stale targetVersion answers 409 VERSION_CONFLICT, so a retry after the gateway's one-hour cache does too.

targetChanged.title: aUEC order with its changed target
targetChanged.description: Only the order's id, status, new versions and stored target after a target change; read the order itself from the job-order snapshot or feed.

id.description: The order's id and the feed key. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

unitId.description: An org unit id as the create options answer it.

target.description: The requested amount in whole aUEC.
